meta.title: Services & pricing · Websites in Geneva & Annecy | Cosmic Studio
meta.description: Showcase sites, shops, apps and ongoing care, with prices on display: a subscription from €10 a month or a quoted project. Geneva, Haute-Savoie and remote.

intro.title: A site that runs, and someone who looks after it.
intro.lead: Prices are on display, because you have better things to do than ask for a quote to find out whether it fits your budget. And you start with a free mockup, with no commitment.

simulator.title: Start small. Add when you need it.
simulator.lead: The base: a showcase page, online and secure, for {price} a month. Each option can be added or removed from one month to the next.

showcase.title: Showcase sites
showcase.description: Present your business, your work and your opening hours, and get found on Google by the people nearby.

shops.title: Shops & bookings
shops.description: Sell online, take appointments, manage memberships. No commission on your sales.

apps.title: Apps
apps.description: A business tool, an app for your customers or members, an assistant that answers frequent questions: on the web or on the phone.

care.title: Visibility & care
care.description: Google visibility, hosting, backups, updates, changes and training: one contact who knows your site.

formats.title: Need extra hands rather than a website?
formats.lead: For teams that already have a product and need reinforcement, or for projects that call for several skills.

mission.title: Day-rate mission
mission.description: An experienced developer joins your team for as long as needed, on site or remotely.

duo.title: Developer + designer duo
duo.description: A brand and a website designed together, from the first sketch to launch.

team.title: Full team
team.description: A small team for projects that need more: several connected apps, data management, customer accounts.

ownership.question: Do I own the site?
ownership.answer: Your texts, images and domain name are yours from day one. The site's code is handed over after {months} months of subscription: that is what keeps the entry price this low. Want it earlier? That is possible, for a transfer fee that depends on the remaining time. For a one-off project, the code is yours on delivery.

edit.question: Can I edit the site myself?
edit.answer: The simplest way is the “Content changes included” option: you send us your texts, photos or opening hours, and it is done. Many people prefer writing to us over learning a tool. If you really want to publish yourself, that is possible: let's talk, it is a custom project.

timing.question: How long until I am online?
timing.answer: For a showcase page: two to three weeks after we receive your texts and photos. For a five-page site: four to six weeks. We give you a date at the start, and we keep it.

stop.question: What happens if I stop?
stop.answer: You let us know, and the site stays online until the end of the paid period. You leave with your content and your domain name. The site's code is included after {months} months of subscription; before that, it is handed over for a fee we tell you from the start.

content.question: Do you also write the texts and take the photos?
content.answer: We help you write and we proofread everything, with the words your customers type into Google in mind. For photos, we work with yours or put you in touch with a local photographer; that is not included in the subscription.

cta.title: Let's make your business shine.
cta.description: Tell us about your business in a few lines. We get back to you within 24 hours with questions, then a free mockup if the project suits you.
